主要内容: This report is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, a Canadian financial institution, detailing the issuance of various senior global medium-term notes. The filing includes information about the pricing, settlement dates, and principal amounts of these notes, which are linked to different financial instruments such as a basket of eight common stocks and the S&P 500 Index. The report also includes legal opinions from Norton Rose Canada LLP and Morrison & Foerster LLP regarding the validity of the notes under Canadian and New York law. The filing is part of the Bank's shelf registration statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The report was published on March 7, 2012, and is intended to be incorporated by reference into the Bank's registration statement.
